text: The itinerary you built has me landing two hours after my connecting flight leaves.
You summarized my report and left out the only section my manager asked about.
The recipe you gave me called for a tablespoon of salt where it should have said a teaspoon.
I asked for a formal apology letter and you opened it with a joke.
Your budget spreadsheet adds the rent twice. Did you check it at all?
The translation you gave me says the opposite of what I wrote.
You told me the pharmacy closes at nine. It closed at six and I drove there for nothing.
The study schedule you made puts three exams' worth of revision on the same evening.
I asked for directions avoiding the toll road and you sent me straight onto it.
Your packing list for a ski trip did not include gloves.
The cover letter you drafted names the wrong company in the first line.
You said the form was due Friday. It was due Wednesday and now I have a late fee.
The workout plan you wrote has me doing heavy squats every single day.
I gave you my notes and you returned a summary of a different book.
The seating chart you made puts my divorced parents side by side.
You converted the measurements wrong and the shelf is four inches too short.
The speech you wrote for the retirement party gets his name wrong twice.
I asked you to shorten the email and you made it longer.
Your reminder went out a day late, so I missed the appointment.
The reading list you gave my daughter includes a book meant for adults.
You told me the train left from platform two. It left from platform nine without me.
The poem I asked for was supposed to rhyme. None of it rhymes.
Your meal plan for my nut allergy has almond flour in three recipes.
The invoice template you made leaves out the tax line entirely.
I asked for a quiet restaurant and you booked the one with live drums.
You fixed one typo in my essay and added four new ones.
The garden layout you drew puts the shade plants in full afternoon sun.
I said no surprises, and the plan you wrote is built around a surprise.
Your instructions for resetting the router wiped all my saved settings.
The birthday message you wrote for my grandmother calls her my aunt.
You scheduled the movers for the day after my lease ends.
The checklist you gave me skipped the step that mattered most.
I asked for three options and you gave me the same option three times.
Your summary of the meeting assigns my tasks to someone who has left the company.
The gift ideas you listed are all things I told you she already owns.
You said the paint would be dry in an hour. It has been a day and it is still wet.
The route you planned for my run goes along a motorway.
I asked you to proofread the menu and you renamed half the dishes.
Your timeline for the project has the launch before the testing.
The lullaby you wrote for my baby mentions thunderstorms and wolves.
You told me to water the orchid daily and now it is rotting.
The flashcards you made for my exam have the answers on the wrong cards.
I asked for a polite reminder and what you wrote sounds like a threat.
Your comparison of the two laptops mixes up which one has the better battery.
The party invitation you drafted gives last year's date.
You rounded every figure in my expense claim and now none of it matches the receipts.
The bedtime routine you suggested starts at midnight.
I asked for a short toast and you gave me four pages.
